subject: Re: Next steps — PoC & deployment mode discussion (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — PoC & deployment mode discussion (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate you and Sara walking us through Acme's requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

Recap (from our notes):
- Primary workload: customer support summarization + retrieval-augmented generation for internal knowledge base (latency target ~300ms p95).
- Data sensitivity: customer PII in prompts/KB; must meet Acme's security controls and auditability.
- Integration constraints: existing VPC in AWS us-west-2; infra team prefers private networking but open to Dedicated if timeline/cost tradeoffs are better.

Ask / success criteria for PoC:
1) Demonstrate model quality parity (same prompts run against candidate open model) — target BLEU/ROUGE delta <5% relative to your golden set.
2) Latency: p95 under 350ms for 2k concurrent requests (simulated traffic).
3) Security: Private VPC connectivity or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS; logging and retention policy audit.
4) Integration: ability to route traffic from your API gateway to Redwood with minimal config and a 2-week rollout window.

Recommended PoC plan (attached a short plan):
- Phase 1 (1 week): Hosted API smoke test with a small dataset to validate prompts and output quality.
- Phase 2 (2 weeks): Dedicated capacity trial to validate throughput and autoscaling (preferred if Acme can't do VPC immediately).
- Phase 3 (2-3 weeks): Private VPC setup (if chosen) with our infra team working with your network/security owners.

If Acme prefers to skip Hosted and go straight to Private VPC, we can accelerate Phase 3 in parallel with Phase 1 tests.

Next steps: can you confirm (by end of week) which deployment mode you'd like to prioritize (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)? Also please share the internal stakeholders and an initial date window for the PoC. We'll set up a mutual action plan and get SRE/infra folks looped in.

I've attached a one-page PoC plan and our standard security questionnaire for your security team to review.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Jordan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf, security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acmecorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lee <sara.lee@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC & deployment mode discussion (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:
- Security is the primary blocker for production. Our security and compliance team will almost certainly require Private VPC (or on-prem) for any production traffic containing PII. For the PoC, they'd accept Dedicated capacity with customer-managed KMS and audit logs, as long as we can show end-to-end controls.
- Timeline: Q3 timeline is ideal, but we want to kick off a PoC ASAP to validate quality decisions by end of June.
- Stakeholders: I'll loop John Patel (Head of Infra) and Laura Kim (Security Lead) if that helps. For now, Sara (copied) will coordinate availability for PoC sign-off.

Can Marissa or Ben share a concrete PoC checklist and an estimated time to get Dedicated capacity spun up (if we go that route)? Also please flag any blockers for Private VPC — we want to understand the work on our side (network peering, firewall rules, KMS integration).

Thanks,
Tom
Director of AI Engineering | Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@acmecorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC & deployment mode discussion (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Hi Tom / team —

Thanks — here's a concrete PoC checklist and estimated timelines. I'm Marissa (Solutions Engineer), I'll own the technical delivery.

Proposed PoC checklist:
- PoC objective: Validate model quality, latency and security posture under a production-like load.
- Data/Inputs: Provide a 1-2k prompt set and a 50-100GB snapshot of non-sensitive KB for retrieval tests (we can redact PII for early tests).
- Success criteria:
  * Quality: average summary accuracy >= your golden set threshold (we'll measure with your metrics)
  * Latency: p95 < 350ms under 2k concurrent simulated users
  * Security: audit logs, KMS integration (if Dedicated), and network isolation for Private VPC verified
- Deliverables:
  * Week 0: PoC plan & test harness (today — attached)
  * Week 1: Hosted API smoke tests (sanity + quality checks)
  * Week 2-3: Dedicated capacity trial (throughput, autoscaling, KMS) — provisioning 3-5 business days after signed trial order
  * Week 4-6: Private VPC onboarding (if chosen) — estimated 2-3 weeks including network peering/testing

Blockers / items we need from Acme:
1) Confirmation of deployment mode preference (Hosted/Dedicated/Private VPC)
2) Contact for network (John Patel) and security (Laura Kim) to review firewall and KMS requirements
3) Test data and success metric thresholds

A couple of notes on Private VPC:
- Typical steps: VPC peering + firewall rules, route table updates, and customer-side KMS setup. We provide a runbook and a templated CloudFormation script to simplify work on your side.
- Time-to-availability: Assuming network approvals, most customers can be up in ~2 weeks; we recommend doing a Dedicated trial in parallel to avoid blocking the PoC while networking is scheduled.

I'll schedule a 30-min tech sync with your infra/security folks — is early next week OK?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (one-pager), security-questionnaire.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — PoC & deployment mode discussion (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Tom / team —

Quick follow-up to lock timeline and next owners.
- Jordan will own commercial (trial agreement / credit card or PO).
- Marissa will own technical delivery and run the test harness.
- I'll coordinate provisioning for Dedicated capacity — estimated 3 business days from signed trial request.

Proposed near-term plan (if you want to move fast):
1) Sign trial agreement (Jordan) — target: next 3 business days.
2) Provision Dedicated capacity in parallel with Hosted API smoke tests (Marissa) — 3 business days provisioning.
3) Schedule infra/security tech sync w/ John Patel + Laura Kim for next Tue (I'll send a calendar invite once we have availability).

If you confirm Private VPC as the priority, we'll do a parallel track: start Dedicated provisioning for functional tests and run Private VPC onboarding with your infra team. That minimizes blocker risk.

Ben
